Title: Tournament Report - Rewind Time: Charlotte, NC

Messages.Author: yafka
Messages.Body:
Rewind Time: Charlotte
22 July 2023
Carolina Tabletop Games, Pineville, North Carolina
2R+F
12 players
Jason Joy
www.vekn.net/event-calendar/event/10896

-- 2GW6 + 4vp in final

It was a good day at the Rewind Time: Charlotte tournament, held at Carolina Tabletop Games. We had 12 players total attend, three of which came from as far away as Marshall, Texas.

After the first two rounds, the top five finalists were:
1. Jason Joy (Mata Hari Inside Dirt) 2 GW 3 VP
2. Matt Hatch (Anarch Gangrel Wall) 1 GW 5VP
3. Felipe Fiuza (Anarch Gangrel) 1 GW 5VP
4. Brenda Joy (Lasombra Stealth Bleed) 3VP
5. Jose Lafuente (Tremere Antritribu Bleed & Block) 1 GW 3VP

Seating order for the Final:
1. Jason Joy
2. Jose Lafuente
3. Felipe Fiuza
4. Brenda Joy
5. Matt Hatch

Final Result:
Jason won the final with 3 VP. Felipe had 2 VP.
All finalists were award with a small stack of various VTES boosters. Jason received a sealed 25th Anniversary Deck Box and a larger stack of boosters.
